title: Linear functional on a pair
statement:
Let $L:\bbr^2\to\bbr$ be a continuous real-linear functional. For all $x,y\in\bbr$,
\[
L(x,y)=xL(1,0)+yL(0,1).
\]
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a continuous real-linear functional on $\bbr^2$
